description: Productivity analytics over tracked time: a daily tracked/manual/billable/activity series plus top apps by active time. Without contractId: the token owner's own analytics (full window-title detail). With contractId: either party's view of that contract — app usage is attributed by overlapping the worker's activity samples with the contract's reconciled cells, and stays APP-LEVEL (no titles/URLs). Range defaults to the trailing 14 days, max 31. Requires time:read scope and the public API time-tracking feature.

contractId.description: Analyze one contract (buyer or worker view, app-level usage). Omit for your own full analytics.

name: opentrain_time_analytics
